name: Berserk
description: Whenever the construct starts its turn with 60 hit points or fewer, roll a d6. On a 6, the construct goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the construct attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the construct attacks an object, with preference for an object smaller than itself. Once the construct goes berserk, it continues to do so until it is destroyed or regains all its hit points.

Whenever the construct starts its turn with 40 hit points or fewer, roll a d6. On a 6, the construct goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the construct attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the construct attacks an object, with preference for an object smaller than itself. Once the construct goes berserk, it continues to do so until it is destroyed or regains all its hit points.
The construct's creator, if within 60 feet of the berserk golem, can try to calm it by speaking firmly and persuasively. The construct must be able to hear its creator, who must take an action to make a DC 15 Charisma (Persuasion) check. If the check succeeds, the construct ceases being berserk. If it takes damage while still at 40 hit points or fewer, the construct might go berserk again.
